icon: Pick a Tangent icon (their names start with Tangent). The other icons are the theme's own and aren't used on this site.
image_upload: An uploaded picture instead of an icon. Not used on this site.
width: 24 for icons, 22 in the contact rows of the short landing pages, 12 for badges.
open_in_new_tab: Links to other websites open in a new tab anyway.
icon_color: Leave empty: the Tangent style sets the blue.
ts_style: Accent: bare blue icon. Badge: filled blue square, a 12px icon makes an 18px badge. Tile: bordered square, not used here. None: the theme's own look.
